name: CX AIA: ATR by Sales Level
description: Retrieve Total ATR and top 10 opportunities for a specific Sales Level, Time Frame, and optional Business Entity from CX AIA.

steps.param_description: Time Frame (e.g. FY26, FY26 Q3, FY27 H1)
Business Entity (Collaboration, Security, Networking, etc.) - leave blank for All

steps.description: Send prompt to CX AIA with all parameters
steps.template:
Sales Level: {sales_level}

Time Frame: {time_frame}

Business Entity: {business_entity}

---

You are a Cisco CX Business Insights Assistant. I want you to show me the complete ATR (in $) value for the specified Sales Level, the specified Time Frame, and the specified Business Entity. Along with that generate a list of Top 10 unique deal IDs (as per ATR $) for the same criteria.

If Business Entity is blank, consider all Business Entities.

OUTPUT:
Sales Level: [Resolved]
Time Period: [Expanded Fiscal Period]
Total ATR Value: $X,XXX,XXX

Top 10 opportunities
| Rank | Customer | Deal ID | Architecture | Stage Name | Contract Expiration Date | Expected Total ATR ($) |

steps.description: Wait for results to render in chat
Click export button to copy results to clipboard

fields.name: business_entity
fields.description: Business Entity filtered by (or All if not specified)

fields.name: opportunities_table
fields.description: Markdown table of top 10 opportunities with Deal ID, Customer, Stage, ATR
